plot_histogram: plot a histogram of a sequence with configurable bins and save to an output file
plot_scatter: plot a scatter plot of multiple sequences against a shared x-axis and save to file
plot_sequence: plot line sequences with configurable axis scales and optional legend, saving to file
plot_pie_chart: plot a pie chart from a dictionary of label-value pairs and save to file
review_plot_functions: review the plot module functions for histogram, scatter, sequence, and pie chart plotting
